title: PoseRieFlow: Riemannian Flow Matching for Whole-Body Text-to-Pose Generation
title_zh: PoseRieFlow：面向全身文本生成姿态的黎曼流匹配

paragraphs.en: PoseRieFlow在SMPL-H旋转流形上用流匹配生成含精细手部的文本驱动三维人体姿态。 We present PoseRieFlow, a compact flow-matching framework for text-conditioned generation of whole-body 3D human poses. Prior text-to-pose methods either neglect articulated hands or model rotations in Euclidean space despite their non-Euclidean geometry. PoseRieFlow instead formulates generation directly on the product manifold of SMPL-H joint rotations, learning a text-conditioned vector field that transports samples from an isotropic $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ Gaussian prior to the data distribution along Riemannian geodesics. A part-tokenized Diffusion Transformer aggregates the 52 joints into eight body-part tokens, allocating a dedicated token and nonlinear projector to each hand, and restores per-joint resolution through part-specific decoders, shortening the sequence while improving kinematic fidelity over per-joint tokenization. With only 21.6M trainable parameters, PoseRieFlow supports expressive SMPL-H generation with detailed hand articulation at a fraction of the scale of recent LLM-based generators. On PoseScript, it attains the lowest whole-body kinematic error among all hand-producing methods, with consistent kinematic gains from the Riemannian formulation over its Euclidean counterpart at every practical inference budget, while distributional and retrieval metrics remain comparable between them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出PoseRieFlow，一个紧凑的流匹配框架，用于文本条件下的全身三维人体姿态生成，在SMPL-H旋转流形上生成包含精细手部的姿态。 已有的文本到姿态方法要么忽略铰接式手部，要么尽管旋转具有非欧几何特性仍在欧氏空间中对旋转建模。 PoseRieFlow则直接在SMPL-H关节旋转的乘积流形上构建生成过程，学习一个文本条件向量场，将样本从各向同性的$\mathrm{SO}(3)$高斯先验沿黎曼测地线输运到数据分布。 一个分部件化的Diffusion Transformer将52个关节聚合为八个身体部件令牌，为每只手分配专用令牌和非线性投影器，并通过部件专属解码器恢复逐关节分辨率，在缩短序列的同时相比逐关节令牌化提升了运动学保真度。 仅有21.6M可训练参数，PoseRieFlow以远小于近期基于LLM生成器的规模，支持具有精细手部动作的表达性SMPL-H生成。 在PoseScript上，它在所有能生成手部的方法中取得了最低的全身运动学误差；在每种实际推理预算下，黎曼建模相对其欧氏对应方法都带来一致的运动学性能提升，而两者的分布和检索指标则大体相当。
